Though he rarely leaves the depths, Bardek’s word holds great sway in the council halls of Karak Norn. His authority comes not from command in war, but from the respect earned through unshakable purpose and quiet wisdom. He ensures that even in the most forgotten reaches of the hold, the names of the dead are remembered and honored. To the young, he is a figure of myth, the grey sentinel beneath the mountain. To the old, he is a keeper of memory, the voice of the past reminding them why they must endure, even in a realm as barren as the Grey Mountains. For Bardek knows that in the end, stone may crumble and gold may fade, but the honor of the Dawi must never be buried.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_factionleader}Having taken the throne a hundred years past, Morgrim Ironforge has waged war and fought innumerous battles against the Greenskin tides pushing from the north and east, all the while holding the under-depths of Zhufbar from the vile Skaven hordes.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_2}Descending from Master Engineer Burlock Damminsonn, Grimm Burloksson is the youngest Dwarf to ever reach the rank of Master Engineer. Although a master of his craft, many Longbeards believe he may be too rebellious to the Engineer Code, believing him to craft and construct designs deemed too ingenious even for his own good.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_3}Having gone through many tribulations in his youth, none even more so than losing his arm to one of his best friends, Sven Haslefresian, Burlok Damminsonn has garnered enough recognition of his peers to be one of the Guildmasters of the Engineers guild. Burlok’s main goal is to steer his son, Grimm Burloksson, in the right direction, and not in the direction his best friend Sven went.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_4}Grom Barakundi, the Gatekeeper of Zhufbar has held the main entrance of Zhufbar long before the birth of his current king, Morgrim Ironforge. He has staved off the threats of Vampire, Greenskin, and Skaven from the gates and walls of Zhufbar for many a millenia, and Grom vows to never see Zhufbar fall to these dreaded enemies.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_5}Many a Dwarf knows the sound of Drammar Azrilbak’s fists, when in the sparring grounds, hence why Drammar has adopted the name “silver fist.” Having been alive quite long for the average Dwarf, Drammar has become a renowned fighter, and has been a Thane for King Morgrim Ironforge for 2 centuries.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_6}Having served in the miners guild in Zhufbar, Rungni Ulfarsson has gained notoriety for his labor in the depths, which eventually lead to him leading a contingent of Ironbreakers to destroy a Skaven nest. Now Rungni leads throngs for his king in the depths and out.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_7}Longbeard and avid Grumbler, Thazzrick Grundmane has a seat on the Council of the Engineer’s guild. Indeed, Thazzrick is one of the few in Zhufbar who want to steer the young Dawi towards tradition. While many don’t listen to him, he is still well respected as a warrior and an elder.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_8}An up and coming Commander for the Armies of Zhufbar, Thrain Dronrifsson upholds a lot of respect among the younglings, having been an Ironbreaker in the mines and caverns, they look to him for guidance and training, and occasionally a drinking companion, so he can tell them all of his stories.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_9}Old Grumbler Huunor, or just “The Old Grumbler” is one of the eldest Dawi currently residing in Zhufbar, so old he is a Living Ancestor for his Clan. He has been a Hammerer in service to Morgrim Ironforge, and the previous Kings, and now commands an army for his “new” liege. In fact many believe Huunor is only alive because he complains, gripes, and grumbles so much, he doesn’t have the time to die, but that is simply a tall tale told by the beardlings.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_zhufbar_first_10}One of the few who remember the grand gromril mines of Karak Varn, Snorri, was one of the head prospectors, when it was besieged by the vile Skaven hordes. With a small band of miners, they made their way back to Zhufbar to swear vengeance against the raki who drove them from their precious minerals.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_factionleader}A natural born leader, and a natural born Dwarf, King Rorek Granitehand is both a formidable warrior, and a renowned “haver of Ale.” Many of King Granitehand’s council members let the “Lord of Ale” do as he wishes, so as to not forfeit their position.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_2}The Great Feast of Karak Ziflin is a ceremony held once a month, and is among the finest feasts in all of Dwarfdom. The organizer is Dorindal Granitehand, cousin to the king. Dorindal is rarely seen not with the King, as he is always by his side filling his kingly mug with Ale. As such, Dorindal has the honors of leading Dawi under his banner, and accompanying him on campaigns whenever the king has need of him.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_3}None hate the elves more in all of Karak Ziflin than Beleran. While on an expedition to gather wood for fermenting barrels in the outskirts of Athel Loren, the expedition encountered Wood Elves protecting the trees and loosed volley after volley. Thinking the expedition depleted, and outnumbered, the poncy Elves went to capture the expedition. Beleran, hidden under his arrow stridden shield, emerged killing three elves and routing the rest, swearing vengeance to those who murdered his kin.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_4}A young and aspiring commander for Karak Ziflin, Garatrik has proven himself worthy to command a throng of stout Dawi. Despite his relatively young age, Garatrik proved his worth by showing King Rorek his strategies to outmaneuvering Wutelgi, a feat many Dwarf have yet to do.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_5}Thane of Rorek Granitehand, Drognir Gruumspit has served Rorek since he became king. A solid Dwarf and valuable ally to have in battle, Drognir has shown capabilities that many Dwarfs will never show in their lifetime. Although he is a strong friend to the King, Drognir has no need for King Rorek’s cousin, Dorindal, believing he wants the Throne for himself.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_6}Legendary Ranger of the Grey Mountains, Snodrik has lived on the road most of his life, hunting beasts and creatures many would never dare to cross. Having amassed a hoard of Gorl for escorting caravans through the treacherous mountains, he decided to settle in Karak Ziflin, where King Rorek uses his intellect in planning trade routes to the empire and beyond.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_7}Long before the reign of Rorek Granitehand, Marek the Elderpick has been mining in the pits of Karak Ziflin. Only recently did he uncover a vein of gold that he finally got reprieve from the mines. For uncovering this massive vein and adding to the treasure vaults, he was given the honor of becoming Thane, and leading troops into battle.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_8}Byrnnoth, son of Enlag, has only recently become a lord and thane for King Granitehand. Most of his adult life he spent guarding the gates of Karak Ziflin, only recently gaining notoriety for fending off a Skaven assassin, who many believe was targeting King Granitehand.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_9}An honoured friend and lord of King Granitehand, Gottri Logansson has been the Runelord for Karak Ziflin for Millenia, forging and inscribing runes on the arms and armours of venerable warriors who have proven their might and endurance to wield them into battle.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dw_lord_karak_ziflin_first_10}For many Dawi, the feast is a special occasion reserved for victories and the honouring of clan and lord. This is quite the opposite for Norr A Bolg. Instead Norr feasts anytime he can. Many of his company carry along meats, mushrooms, and ale for him to devour so his wrath is taken out on his enemies instead of his pantry.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_factionleader}Warlord of the Bad Axes and a self-appointed rival of Louen Orc-slayer. Gromodrak Hoofslasha is a feared old and cunning Orc warboss riding the magnificent leader of the Hagranyms called Hagroar. More than 300 years ago, Gromodrak was defeated and pushed back into the mountains by a humie boss called Louen, who was even granted the name ‘Orc-slayer’. Set on revenge, Gromodrak retreated into the Grey Mountains to once more muster the surrounding tribes. Unaware of the Orc-slayer’s passing, Gromodrak believes his rival is now called King Louen Leoncoeur and lives north of the Grey Mountains. Gromodrak is preparing his tribe for a real propa Waaagh! to destroy King Louen once and for all.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_2}The mighty Bazodrak is a fierce Orc Boss keen on fighting as many knights as possible. He is often the first one to charge into enemy ranks with little regard for his own life. Although not as old or big as Gromodrak, he’s close to matching the Warboss’ fighting skill.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_3}Kazorak often leads the raiding party set out by Gromodrak. Due to their fast Hagranym mounts, the Greenskins are often not spotted until it's too late for their victims. Kazorak loves to wield different choppas on every raid he leads.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_4}Kragdut is a true Orc mountaineer. With his powerful arms and legs, he is often seen climbing the highest peaks of the Grey Mountains. With the blessing of Gork Kragdut uses his incredibly muscular body to fight the strongest knights and especially loves to fight at high altitudes.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_5}Zoghag has no tongue, resulting in weird pitches when shouting his boss's orders. Nonetheless, he is a tough killa personally ending the tales of numerous knights.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_6}Zurdrakka was once in love with a River Troll Hag. After a Brettonian knight called Tristan the Troubadour put an end to this romance, Zurdrakka made an oath of revenge. Together with his Hagranym, he scouts Brettonian lands, searching for his arch enemy and demanding Tristan’s head.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_7}Kraggoth, blessed by Mork, is a hunter — an Arrer Boy Big Boss. Kraggoth has a keen nose and is a master scout, often finding lost travellers only to cruelly take their lives. He is often mocked for using a bow by his fellow Orcs, but Kraggoth knows a big bow is more than enough to bring a sure death to all humies.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_8}Gollog is not often seen on the surface or the high mountain peaks. He would rather stay in the dark, deep caves of the Grey Mountains. But once Gollog leaves his cave home, trouble is sure to follow, for Gollog is the meanest and fastest Orc in da tribe. Swinging his choppa with such speed, even his boys can’t follow his movements.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_9}Snazzlig, a Goblin Big Boss and second in command to Gromodrak, proved his ferocious skill by defeating Kragdrut and Zoghag in battle. No Orc knows where Snazzlig got his immense strength, but the boys are sure he is blessed by Gork.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_first_10}Glartnibz leads a pack of wolf ridas. His bloodthirsty pack often travels together with Kraggoth, hunting down all humies foolish enough to try and cross the mountain passes.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_second_2}Granug used to be a great fighter and adventurer, but one day he took an enormous arrow to the knee.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_second_4}Few have crossed the towering hulk that is Zogrosh and lived to tell the tale, even fewer have survived his fondness for punching his enemies into a red mist, to the awe and horror of allies and enemies alike.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bad_axes_second_5}Through dance and combat Stugon Bone Danca channels the mighty energies of the great greenskin gods Gork and Mork, or was it Mork and Gork?, to devastating effect. He cares little whether enemies, allies or goblins get caught in his potent magicks, just as long as the gods are pleased with the devastation.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_factionleader}Zorbak Bearthwakka originally comes from a tribe of Black Orcs. Killing great numbers of Dwarfs over the years, Zorbak was ultimately defeated by a Dwarfen Slayer. Left for death by his tribe but with Gork’s blessing Zorbak survived. Over time, he recovered and founded his tribe: the Black Sunz, living in the World’s Edge Mountains at the border of the planes of Zharr-Naggrund. When Zorkbak heard of the great Waaagh! tearing through the faraway Brettonia, he and his tribe moved towards this mighty battle. Due to the harsh travels through the mountains, the Black Sunz tribe were weeks late. When they finally arrived, they were faced with a field full of dead Greenskins. Soon after, the knights of Bretonnia surrounded them, and they had a mighty last battle. Zorbak was gravely wounded, but once again with the blessing of Gork survived. Now living in the isolated caves of the Pale Sisters, Zorbak tries to muster forces once more to have the real final battle.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_2}Zurhog is a mighty fighter, having seen much of the Old World and faced countless different foes. Although Zurhog lost several battles at the hands of humies, he still hates stunties above all.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_3}Zagdug is known to be an instigator of internal fighting. In his opinion, propa fightin’ makes the boys stronger and ready for battle. Although halted by other Bosses, Zagdug keeps at it, often getting himself into the heat of battle.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_4}Bazdrak is da Boss of a small company of boar ridas under the command of Zorbak. Bazdrak often leads the vanguard, dealing devastating blows to the enemy forces.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_5}Zarklok is a lazy Orc but a great fighter. He has a strange habit of picking up the most brutal and nastiest-looking weapon after battle, only to use it in his next fight and swap it again.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_6}Zakkhag is not a large Orc, but his wide build makes up for his smaller stature. It is even said that Zakkhag once wrestled a troll twice his size and came out on top. Da boys he leads often call him the champion of the Black Sunz.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_7}Gazodrag has the foulest odour in the entire tribe. His whole body is covered in waste, even da choppas. His scent is so strong that enemies at a smelling distance often suffer extreme nausea.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_8}Dazgut is a horrendously cruel Orc, often forcing smaller Orcs and Goblins to do harsh labour. Dazgut is an overseer of the fortifications and a scrap collector. He has a piercing gaze that inflicts great terror on the working crews, making them work harder.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_9}Dazodra loves hunting down prey and stalking the mountains for lost travellers or Questing Knights. He is often confused for a Savage Orc for wearing mostly tribal armour and carrying a bow.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_first_10}Orgul has a massive axe that no other Orc except for Zorbak can pick up; it is just too heavy. In his opinion, every one of the boys could pick it up, they just need to ‘get da fing up’.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_second_1}Few Orcs can claim to love horns and spikes more than Mangla Bloodtusk, and fewer still derive his level of satisfaction when impaling enemies on those very spikes. The many sharp protrusions from his helmet lead to his ‘luv of ‘eadbuttin’ gits’ and few can stand their ground against a fearsome orc charging at you, like a rage filled bull.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_second_2}Borbog's enthusiasm for bloody mutilation earned him the moniker of ‘Red Killa’, as he would roam the battlefield, tearing his foes apart and waving their limbs about in a glee-filled trance, spraying himself and others with a red, bloody mist.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_second_3}Orcs are tough; they can shrug off wounds that would make most men cry out in agony. Even then, Umlodd Tuffgit is the toughest of the lot, often going out of his way to get wounded simply to prove that he is nigh unbeatable in ‘tuffness’.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_second_4}Some believe Nog Gutgrowla wanted to prove an Orc could be just as fat as Grom the Paunch; others believe he is somehow related to ogres, given that he’s always hungry. Whatever the reality, his immensely fat frame only adds to the awesome power and force that he brings to battle

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_sunz_second_5}Some goblins whisper that Grut Da Skreetcha was cursed with ‘da voice of a bat’, as his voice is oddly high-pitched for an orc, and his penchant for howling at others makes it worse. Yet neither Gork nor Mork seem to have an issue with it, as his ear piercing screeches call forth the mighty magics of the orcs with unbound ferocity.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_factionleader}Killer of the Dawi-Zharr Daemon and successor to the Crooked Eye tribe. Bazglud promises much fighting and prosperity to the tribe. Building their weakened numbers to full strength, ready for a Waaagh! Bazglud is a brutal and cunning warrior for an Orc. His face is covered in red paint to remind his tribe who killed the red fire Daemon. This has become a sign of loyalty. With all the Bosses painting their faces red in respect to their chief.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_2}Second in command and survivor of the Dawi-Zharr onslaught. Aggad Da Big is a huge Orc. Saved by Bazglud from being decapitated by the fire Daemon. Aggad now pledges his life to fight beside Bazglud. Painted in red, this hulking Orc is a true terror to face on the battlefield.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_3}Part of Bazglud’s inner circle is Grombak, head of the hunters and Arrer Boys. His aim is terrible, but with enough boys at his side, nobody notices. He is especially good at shouting orders.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_4}Equipped with his hefty axe, Morngor is ever-ready for battle. Few dare to challenge him, and Morngor is often used as the battle champion of the tribe.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_5}Bestowed with the gift of magic, Bazgoth is an Orc shaman. As an advisor of the gods' will and wielder of potent magic, Bazgoth is often seen as the second in command aside from Aggad. The two often quarrel, but Bazgot mostly wins the arguments due to his greater knowledge.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_6}Originally one of the Big Bosses of the long-forgotten Giant’s Foot tribe, Morlog suffered a defeat against Bazglud in a duel. After the battle, he submitted to his new overlord. Regarded as a coward for not fighting to the death, Morlog carries a great shame and dreams of being able to challenge Bazglud once more.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_7}Fast and agile, this Orc has already planted his club between the foe’s shoulders before they could react. For Skororak, the Waaagh! is a pilgrimage to show true violence.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_8}Exiled from his first tribe and a survivor of the destruction of his second tribe, Molglot is now a veteran Big ‘Un of the Crooked Eye tribe. Due to his un-orcish survival skills, Molglot has always stayed alive to fight another battle and to join another Waaagh! He now leads a regiment of weathered Arrer Boys.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_9}Exiled by the Necksnappers tribe, Boggurk has found a new home in the Crooked-Eye tribe. And he has sworn revenge on his old tribe – Boggurk’s mighty fist will crush those weaklings.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_10}Loud and obnoxious Thunderfoot always wants to be heard. A smaller but influential Orc leading a band of boyz, Thunderfoot is always recognisable on the battlefield due to his loud screaming, often ruining surprise attacks.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_first_11}Groshnok is always seen talking to himself, or rather, talking to his other personality. While one of his personalities is quite rational and cunning, the other is wild and ferocious.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_1}Urbad enjoys mocking his opponents, ripping out their eyes and consuming 'em on the spot.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_2}Grubuk wears a big number of gold rings on his tusks. What a fancy lad.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_3}An Orc Shaman who considers abundant spitting a crucial part of any cursing ritual.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_4}Acts as a ‘strategy advisor’ to the Warboss. A real go-getter with a bright future ahead of him.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_5}This Orc Boss does not concern himself with choppas of any kind. Instead, Horug insists on using a massive bone to smash his enemies to a bloody pulp. The bone is his battle trophy from the time Horug single-handedly killed a Troll leader.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_6}A very serious Orc Shaman, unorthodox for his kind. Probably a side effect of all the fumes he is always inhaling at the camp.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_7}Spends most of his free time on sharpening his teef until they are “proppa killy”.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_8}Not the sharpest choppa in the camp, even by Greenskin standards. But quite proficient at killing humies.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_crooked_eye_second_9}An Arrer Big Boss leading a mob, one of the rare Arrer Boy wins for sure.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_factionleader}The Warboss of the Deff Grindaz tribe and the warmonger of conflicts against the Dwarfs and Wood Elves, nobody is safe in the presence of Zorkar. Being a gigantic orc, Zorkor has no problems with ruling over his tribe. With the iron fist and a big grin, Zorkar rules with fear. He also personally slew more than a hundred Elves, Dwarfs and Humies.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_2}Golmod is the owner of a massive choppa, which he uses to cut down trees, to taunt the Elves and Forest Spirits. Golmod's mob has invaded many halls of Athel Loren, and to the surprise of the Elves, has survived any retaliation from the inhabitants of the forest.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_3}Experienced in ‘humie fings dat lob roks', Zolog knows how to counter the heaviest of artillery — by throwing more Goblins at the problem while he and the boys charge head-on.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_4}Known to his enemies by his powerful odor, Bolg is known as a stinky one bathing in dung to paralyse his enemies with the smell.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_5}Aggressive and scrap-loving Olork is quickly bored and doesn’t shy away from questioning other Bosses. He is often the first one to challenge others to “keep up da spirit uv da boys”.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_6}Cunning with an edge of brutality, Gurbak makes for a fine follower of Mork. Leading his less intelligent tribesmen into battle with “proppa Orc taktiks”.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_7}Riding a huge war boar, Uggut is considered the best rida in the tribe, leading the boar boys into the fray.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_8}Famous and hated in every Dwarfen hall of Karak Norn, Ragdak Dwarfrippa has earned a proper stunty grudge. After killing a travelling party of stunty women. Ragdak has become a major target for hunting parties looking to settle this grudge once and for all.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_first_9}Dolglut hates stunties with every inch of his body, and only lives to rip off their beardy ‘eads.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_1}Cragskar is just mean, da meanest, baddest Orc. Until someone even meanest and even baddest comes along.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_2}Terror of the Athel Loren Asrai – Glob wields a giant shield that makes him nigh immune to frontal attacks.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_3}An Orc Shaman Lord addicted to shroom concoctions and bug soup. One might even consider Bugzzaz a cook lord if not for the terrible hexes he can inflict on the foe.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_4}A very green orc. His favorite activity is rushing out of forest shrubs and ambushing unsuspecting prey.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_5}A towering Black Orc, infamous for carrying dual choppas in hand, and two extra choppas at his belt.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_6}A Greenskin of muscle and mass, Dolruk has become accustomed to the hagbane-tipped arrows of the host from Athel Loren. Due to his resilience, the Wood Elves struggle in dealing with the hulking beast, trying to resort to other tactics. However, all their options seem fruitless, for Dolruk loves fighting the Wood Elf hosts, and they never get a chance to change their strategy.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_7}Skaldrut has a hobby of cutting down Forest Spirits, which he finds more entertaining boring humies. He plans on becoming the next Warboss and leading the next Waaagh! into Athel Loren.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_deff_grindaz_second_8}Zogolga doesn’t say much except for “Waaagh!” or “WAAAGH!”. Nevertheless, other boys seem to have no trouble understanding orders shouted by Zogolga.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_factionleader}Snagga Ironbita is the current Warboss of the Iron Orcs. A towering hulk of muscle and black armour, Snagga is a truly peerless leader, and it would be most unwise to disregard him as a mindless brute. Calm and calculating (for an Orc), Snagga’s strategic raids have left the humies ruling surrounding lands truly perplexed. The boys of the Iron Tribe started calling Snagga the ‘Ironbita’ after he snapped ‘sum ‘umie git’ sword in two with his teef alone.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_2}Not that long ago, Guzor challenged Snagga to a fight, hoping to overthrow the Warboss. Snagga won that duel but did not fail to recognise the ferocious fighting style of his rival. Guzor now serves as Snagga’s right hand, hoping to challenge the Warboss again in the future. The boys of the tribe learned to scatter quickly when Guzor is walking by, as he’s utterly merciless and greedy. Many promising lads met their deaths by Guzor’s choppa. One spiteful glare or an insufficient tribute in Teef or shiny stuff is all it takes to attract Guzor’s ire.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_3}Crazag had a dream — To be da best and baddest Orc Bully to ever oversee a rock lobber. However, all rock lobbers he ever approached proceeded to promptly break down. This was usually preceded by a confused: “Guh, wuz diz metal bits???” from Crazag. Fortunately, the tenacious Orc did not give up and managed to turn his aspirations around. Now, whenever he marches into battle, Crazag surrounds himself with ‘trusty Goblin volunteers’ to throw and bombard the enemy with. Unsurprisingly, most Goblins prefer to take their chances as living missiles rather than serve as a potential snack.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_4}There is only one thing Rugud adores more than a good scrap: war boars. He loves feeding ‘em, riding ‘em, petting ‘em, chopping ‘em, and eating ‘em. For Rugud, there is no sweeter sound in the world than the squealing of a boar. While most boys tend to celebrate their victorious fights with additional fighting and quarrelling, Rugud prefers tending to his pet war boar, Pigtusk. It’s not uncommon to see him personally feed Pigtusk or even lovingly brush its hide with a smaller choppa.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_5}There is only one thing Braggat adores more than a good scrap: dead Goblins. He loves kicking ‘em, bullying ‘em, chopping ‘em, slashing ‘em, and eating ‘em. For Braggat, there is no sweeter sound in the world than the screams of a Goblin. While most boys tend to celebrate won fights with additional fighting and quarrelling, Braggat prefers running around the war camp chasing Goblins to bully or eat. It’s not uncommon to see him wrestle a Troll for that tasty Goblin snack. In battle, Braggat is a menace not only to his enemies but also to any Goblin among his ranks.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_6}Even among his Black Orc tribesmen, Narlok is unusual. Overly grim and serious, he firmly refuses to engage in unfair fights. A choppa to the back, uneven odds or mount advantage – Narlok rejects such notions and insists on strict one-on-one fights. He also won’t hesitate to cut down any overzealous Orc that dares interfere in these duels. This, of course, does not make Narlok too popular with the boys, but they have little choice in the matter of command. Might makes right after all.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_7}To call Karug a dimwit would be the understatement of the century. Indeed, one might have an easier time finding a lean Halfling than looking for intelligence in Karug’s actions. Da boys suspect his condition involves local Trolls and repeated blows to the head, but nevertheless, they can appreciate such simplicity in their Bosses. Fortunately for Karug, a trusty choppa is more than enough to smash in sum ‘umie or stunty skulls.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_8}There are two extraordinary qualities to Skargut: his martial prowess and the abhorrent odour. 5 years ago, during a raid on Bretonnian lands, Skargut was seen duelling the enemy commander – A humie noble donning shiny armour. Both combatants seemed evenly matched, but Skargut’s opponent made one fatal mistake. That is, he got too close to the Orc during a clinch and dropped dead with a single whiff of Skargut’s stink. Ever since that time, Skargut has been accompanied by a small mob of loyal Big ‘Uns intent on gobbling down the most foul-smelling foodstuffs, with the hope of gaining just a bit of their Boss’s might.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_first_9}Trug is the chief shaman of the Iron Tribe. Whenever he isn’t busy hexing insubordinate Orcs, Trug spends most of his time staring into the camp bonfire and inhaling the fumes. This allows him to commune with Gork (or Mork) and enter a particular battle trance. Most orders shouted in this state are utterly unintelligible, but weirdly enough, the boys have little difficulty in following them and smashing the enemy.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_1}Big toff guy
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_2}Orc Shaman fella
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_3}Beats up Black Orcs in duels idk
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_4}Chops off legs of enemies and hits em wiv it
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_5}Uses a huge hammer, that’s his life story

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_6}Zugrok is most likely the oldest Orc of the Iron Tribe. A veteran of numerous scraps and conflicts, he was part of the great Black Orc migration from the Plains of Zharr. However, a quarrel and a lost duel against Morglum Necksnapper led to Zugrok leaving the Necksnappers and joining forces with Snagga. His weathered and scarred face is often enough to send most enemies running back to their stone castles.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_7}Gurnak stands taller than most Iron Orcs. Clad in the distinctive black armour and wielding an enormous choppa in each hand, a battle-ready Gurnak transforms into a black whirlwind of blood and death. Any foe foolish enough to engage Gurnak will be chopped to bloody bits.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_iron_tribe_second_8}Dimnak lives for killing Dwarfs – The only good stuntie is a dead stuntie. He is infamous for carrying out numerous raids on stuntie outposts in The Vaults and collecting stuntie skulls to proudly display these bearded trophies. But despite this bloodlust, Dimnak is a cunning foe: He realizes Dwarfs are tough gits, and their armor vastly outperforms most scrap the boys can cobble together. That is why Dimnak is usually seen sharpening his choppa and practising the most efficient tactics of slaying stunties in one blow.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_factionleader}Skulgul Horsesmakka is the current boss of the Massif Choppas. Skulgul came to be the leader by accidentally killing the former boss. After a bloody skirmish, the former chieftain put on a dead horse’s head, declaring himself the Horsechoppa. Skulgul, who was stunned by a recent hit, picked up his massive choppa and hacked at the horse head, killing the boss in one blow. Confused as to what happened, Skulgul cheered nonetheless and was made chieftain.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_2}Mordrog, Skulgul’s second in command and the tribes spiritual leader. He is known amongst his tribe for killing Brettonian humies with stomps and kicks summoned from his bare hands. Mordrog is a devout follower of Gork for violence is the solution to everything.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_3}Ugok loves fighting horses. Many boys think that horses are weak, but after experiencing a hoof to the face, Ugok knows the opposite to be true. He loves to challenge them and smash ‘em to the ground, only to taste their flesh afterwards.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_4}Third in command is Zakkbad, who is a cunning and merciless fighter. In battle, he enjoys riding in the vanguard and coldly staring at the enemy. Unlike other boys, Zakkbad is usually calm and doesn't lose his temper as fast. Zakkbad is often seen with Nibsnik in the caves, getting fed weird mixtures of shrooms at different times in the day.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_5}Dakkogoth Horserippa loves ripping horses from under knights. Usually, Dakkogoth focuses on riders in battle, pulling the steeds from underneath their riders, resulting in fatal crashes. He challenges himself to rip apart the biggest horses. When the foes are underwhelming, he tends to rip the boars from underneath the boys as well.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_6}Blessed by the hand of Gork, Doldrakk has unusually large arms and hands. With these huge fingers, Doldrakk can throw ‘bigga fings’ from a much larger range than regular orcs.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_7}Due to a rare mutation, the appearance of Kraggut isn’t like the other orcs. Where most of the boys have muscular bodies, Kraggut has a belly and a big one at that, shaming even some of the ogres that sometimes pass through the area. Nonetheless, Kraggut is one of the best boar riders from his tribe, utilising his belly as a battering ram.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_8}Stogrut is the only goblin in Massif Orcal allowed to lead the boys into battle. Who appointed him a boss nobody knows or remembers, but as long as Stogrut brings ‘em to good fighting, they don’t care.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_9}There is much Grimgul does not understand. What he understands very well is driving his choppa through weak bodies of horse humies, and he excels at it.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_10}The shaman of the Massif Choppas Tribe and advisor to Skulgul is Nibsnik. This sneaky goblin shaman is an expert in the use of potent shroom potions, increasing the fighting ability of the boys.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_11}Zaggork does the slashing, while his rival Zoggark does the smashing.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_first_12}Zoggark does the smashing, while his rival Zaggork does the slashing.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_1}A brutish and not very intelligent orc. Although he's not very different from the rest of the orcs in his clan. He led a roving clan of very small orcs, and upon reaching Massif Orcal, there was no need to even fight Skulgul Horsesmakka, as they both knew Vishus would be defeated. So he joined with his boys to make his clan slightly larger.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_2}A normal, nondescript orc. He would not lead a group normally, but he has beaten everyone who has ever opposed him to the point where people follow him just so they do not get slapped by him too.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_3}Yep, das a shaman allright.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_4}Slapdud is a rather peculiar orc shaman. It's rare to see him in his shamanic robes, and he always accompanies the boys whenever there is a fight, as he prefers to fight hand-to-hand and feel the crushing of bones with his enormous staff, which he uses like a hammer. Despite that, he knows the basic Da Big Waaagh spells. But he always prefers to smash things with his staff.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_5}Zguk is an orc who worships Gork above all else. He is always fighting with Mguk to prove that ‘Gork is da best’.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_6}Mguk is an orc who worships Mork above all else. He is always fighting with Zguk to prove that ‘Mork is da best’.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_7}An orc who calls himself an inventor, but has yet to invent anything that doesn't explode or kill anyone who tries to use it. He believes that the secret to making everything work is based on the paint you use to cover it. But so far it has not worked.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_8}The orc with the worst sense in the world. Anything horrible to a normal person (or even other orcs) is worthy of his admiration. If it were up to him, they'd be 'those sour fruits from da palm trees' in the Tilean kitchen, sculptures would be objects stuck to walls or upside down, and he would probably even promote a more 'Brutal-ist' architecture.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_9}A vulgar orc who tends to isolate himself from the crowd whenever he can, committing mischief on his own. When it comes to allocating the most valuable loot, nobody thinks about him. But luckily, he tricks some goblins into being his helpers when it comes to committing villainy outside the control of the other members of the boys.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_massif_choppas_second_10}‘ERE WUZ SUM ZOGGIN’ FINGZ ABOUT BAGDUD, BUT DEY ENT MAKE SENSE. ALL YER GITS NEED TA KNOW IZ BAGDUD IZ DA BEST AN’ BADDEST!!!

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_factionleader}Morglum Necksnapper is the Black Orc Warboss of the Necksnapper Tribe. Originating from the Chaos Dwarf plains in the east. Most Orcs are loud and quarrelsome, but Black Orcs are quiet and stern. This is especially true of Morglum, who appears to be almost entirely fearless. Morglum is renowned for his short battle cries and terse tactical observations.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_2}Oglok the 'Orrible is a massive Orc Big Boss who acts as Morglum Necksnapper's second-in-command. Oglok's tribe lived in the Badlands and was defeated by Morglum’s Black Orcs. Oglok was so impressed by the Black Orc leader that he decided to ally with Morglum. Since then, he has fought in many battles alongside the Black Orcs, leading his boys against humies and stunties. Oglok is a seasoned Orc veteran and bears many battle scars. His powers of leadership are second only to Morglum himself.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_3}Gazak has been part of the Necksnapper Tribe since the beginning. He is a devout follower of his Warboss, Morglum, and has seen his fair share of combat, subjugating many tribes and killing foes over the years.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_4}An angry and ferocious fighter covered in white skull paint. Skulgud loves beheading his enemies. He’s often the first to clash into enemy lines to decapitate and collect as many grisly trophies as he can.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_5}Dakkgad was once a slave of the Dawi-Zharr. When he was being transported to another work camp, the slave caravan came under attack. Luckily for Dakkgad, it was fellow Greenskins that came to kill the Chaos Dwarfs. The warband led by Morglum offered the Black Orc a place amongst his ranks if he swore loyalty. Dakkgad is now a renowned vanguard leader in the great horde, overwhelming any foe with his great strength.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_6}Cunningly brutal, this Big ‘Un is the head of the horde’s scouting party. Agdrut likes his position, for it allows him to lead his boys into battle as soon as possible.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_7}Former leader of the Purple Chewa tribe, Skorbad, chose to follow Morglum after a one-sided defeat. He was swallowed by the mighty Necksnappers horde and rode to the west, joining in the battle of Death Pass.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_8}Ugfang was stuck inside a system of caves for a long time, but he survived. It is said some Night Goblin slaves found him when scouting new tunnel ways in the World’s Edge Mountains. They encountered a big, feral-looking Orc that killed many of their mates before they cunningly decided to bomb him with their special shroom bombs. Once on the surface, Ugfang was beaten into submission and returned to his senses.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_9}This heavy-clad ork is good at punching and also good at receiving punches. A lot of orcs wonder what would happen if he punched himself. So Skarglud brought it to the test, and to his surprise, his punches did little to no damage. Furious with this discovery, he keeps punching himself to feel any pain. The sight of this made most of Skarglud’s boys afraid of their boss, seeing such powerful blows do nothing that they obey without question. This orc must be one of da toughest in the camp.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_first_10}The Great Shaman of the Necksnapper tribe has the important task of supporting da boyz with “spellz and stuffs” so that they can fight ‘arder while the stunties and humies can’t run away from the battle.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_second_1}Wields da biggest choppa you have ever seen. Real tough guy, do not mess with him.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_second_2}Rips out teef of his enemies while they are still alive idk.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_second_3}Orc Shaman lord, enjoys making fires, dancing around them and staring into the night sky. Supposedly, he speaks to the moon, but does the moon answer?

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_second_4}Even the oldest Bosses do not know the name of this Black Orc. Rippa Ov Armz, unsurprisingly, got his moniker from tearing off the arms of his still-breathing opponents.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_second_5}Kazbad has proven his skill when he fought a towering Ogre one-on-one. With the Ogre’s defeat, Kazbad assumed the title of Mawgouger for both disrespecting the Big Maw and striking the Ogre’s maw so hard his head almost did a full spin.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_second_6}This young Big Un has risen through the ranks, defeating most of his tribesmen with ease. While he is still relatively young and inexperienced, most of the other Big Uns don’t take him that seriously. But Azgor is eager to prove that, in time, he can surely beat anyone.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_neck_snappers_second_7}Skultrag loves to lop off heads of stunties. He finds them cowardly, for when scrap time is there, they cower behind their big stone walls instead of fighting Skulotrag. They also fight with boomsticks from range, the cowards. That's why Skulotrag rides a boar, so the stunties cannot escape.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_factionleader}A cruel and harsh leader, not many would dare to challenge Ugrok for his leadership. The ones that do are quick to find their heads rolling from their shoulders. Having enormous strength, Ugrok can pierce the hardest of steel and causes his foes to tremble at his sight. Some boys even say Ugrok would be able to beat a Giant in a duel.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_first_2}Second in command. Snorko One-Finger is a vicious fighter who occupies himself with keeping the boys in check. Wearing his heavy plate armour, Snorko is often seen on the frontline, smashing the heads of enemies with blows so powerful they could shatter rocks.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_first_3}Snog lives for the Waaagh! Smashing and crushing fings is all he cares about. This veteran of the Skullsmasherz tribe is a horrifying foe to encounter on the battlefield, using unorthodox ways of fighting to crush his foes.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_first_4}Olgork always carries his bow and arrers. He is often ridiculed for using such a cowardly weapon. Nonetheless, Olgork kills as efficiently as any Big Boss. Not very efficient at aiming, but Olgork pulls the bowstring with so much strength that his targets often explode into puddles of blood.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_first_5}Zummork Skrap-heaf is a tough fighter and a self-proclaimed poet. He is rather thick but has a way with words like no other Orc. Rhyming about the WAAAGH! before every scrap and his killing blows.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_first_6}Long ago, Molg was part of the great WAAAGH! led by Grom the Paunch. After days at sea battling the Asur, Molg’s ship sank to the depths. Washing up on the coast of Bretonnia, Molg found himself joining the Skullsmasherz, shifting his allegiance and making himself useful again.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_first_7}Gakroz is an Orc Great Shaman and wields powerful magic of Gork (or Mork?). He is one of the few to sometimes oppose Ugrok's decisions and can get away with it. Destructive spells of da Big Waaagh! cast by Gakroz usually don’t leave any trace of the poor gits that dared to face him in battle.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_first_8}Gazagkh is the Boss of Boar Boys, leading his vanguard headlong into the fray. Originally, Gazagkh fought for a different tribe, but his Boss’ defeat caused Gazagkh and his band of Orcs to seek worthy fights elsewhere. Now, Gazakgh has found his true purpose in raiding the caravans looking to cross Axe Bite Pass.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_1}Once upon a time Gutlob once caused such a massacre in the valley that the mountain slopes were flowing with blood and gore. The End.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_2}Big Boss of Boar Boys, enjoys trampling his enemies to the point his beloved war boar is drenched with blood. No, that does not make it run any faster.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_3}Do not cross this Orc Shaman, he is stark raving mad. Seriously, do not even try it. All it takes is one mad glance of Duzzrag’s crazy eyes for the nearby Boys to disperse in great haste.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_4}Kugg takes great pleasure in collecting and cleaning the skulls of his foes. It is not long after these grisly trophies adorn his war helmet.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_5}This bulky Black Orc Boss possesses surprising reflexes and agility for his size. Local Boyz are slightly suspicious of such dexterous fighting style – They suspect it is the work of Cluzz Mad Eye and his shady concoctions.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_6}WIP Gobbo

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_7}Razzglit, an Orc Shaman, wields the magic of Da Big Waaagh! While invoking hexes and curses to debilitate the foe and empowering his bigger kin in battle, Snazznat is still a cunning leader who controls crucial manoeuvres on the battlefield.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_skull_smasherz_second_8}With his severe lack of intelligence and unrivalled strength, Dorkork often finds himself winning the most desperate of battles, killing as many of his boys as enemies. Very few can claim to be dumber than Dorkork, but with Gork’s blessing, he doesn’t need to think about losing or even think at all!

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_factionleader}Snagla Grobspit is a legendary goblin lord famous for driving the humans out of the Drakwald forest and for being the leader of the Redvenom clan. Famous for his spider breeding and the massive Arachnaroc spider lairs. His chilling battle screech is said to be unrivaled among goblins.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_2}Glartstik Kunnintongue is one of the most loyal goblins in Snagla Grobspit’s tribe. Always ready to shed human blood alongside him. His devotion to Snagla is seen as a sycophancy by the rest of the goblins.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_3}Globnank Shroomspore is a shaman of the Redvenom tribe. Before a fight, he has a habit of ingesting venom from a type of spider called Purple Skullbacks. The toxins, which have stupefying effects, make him immune to pain and enhance his magical abilities, at the cost of temporarily driving him insane while the effects last.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_4}Zonkzag Snottoof is one of the main breeders of black pit spiders. He is the one who oversees the growth and development of the new spiders and selects those that are suitable to be mounted by their peers.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_5}Grulsnag Cankersniffa is a famed spider rider of the Redvenom clan. Equal parts stealthy and venomous, he inspires confidence among the other riders who ride alongside him.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_6}Stiznik Hackbagz is the most important night goblin in the small community of night goblins that inhabit the Black Pit. He and his ilk make their living by trading with the forest goblins and cooperating with them to defend their part of the Drakwald forest.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_7}Rakzag Cacklestikka is one of the most successful goblin ambushers the Drakwald forest has ever seen. He is primarily responsible for ensuring that no scouting party gets too close to the cesspool. If they do, he makes sure none can tell.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_8}Grulwonk Dirtnose is the forest goblin shaman in charge of creating and overseeing the production of all the poisons that the other goblins will use against their enemies. Because of this, he is a highly respected and prestigious goblin within the Black Pit.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_9}Naffglat Slugcrawla is a nasty creature even by other goblin standards. He's slippery, kleptomanic, and irritating. In battle, there are always other goblins fighting alongside him, but they only do it to see if they can kill him once and for all.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_10}Ignok Danksplatta is the most famous archer in all of Black Pit. And also one of the goblins who is quickest to flee when things start to go wrong.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_11}Grulnat Poisongobba is one of the goblin shamans of the Black Pit. He is often seen collecting the bones of the unfortunate people who die in the Drakwald forest to experiment on them in his little rituals.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_black_pit_first_12}Nazrunk Gunkpokkitz is responsible for guarding the entrance to the great Arachnarok Spiders' burrows. A position of great prestige, but also dangerous.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_factionleader}Gnashrak Gloomguzzla can boast of being one of the richest goblins in the Old World. Such is the fame of his wealth that numerous creatures from every corner of the world flock to him for the chance to serve him in exchange for a fraction of that wealth. And Gnashrak never turns down expendable volunteers to use as a wall of meat for his enemies.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_first_2}Kakglat Deathgutz is one of the main shamans of the Bloody Spearz tribe. He often ventures into Sylvania alone, taking advantage of his proximity to try to steal something shiny or something to put into his cauldron of potions; from herbs to remains of any animal… or thing.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_first_3}Snufflak Wolfbita is a skilled rider who rides the largest and strongest wolf available in the Bloody Spearz clan.The wolf he rides has bitten him on more than one occasion, but Snufflak doesn't seem to mind and is always willing to try to mount him again in the hope that another bite won't tear off his reins arm.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_first_4}Kakrunk Venommullet is the most expendable shaman in the Bloody Spearz tribe. That's why instead of using him as a shaman, he's used as an emissary to other greenskin tribes. They don't know him, so he can pass himself off as a real shaman and command a modicum of respect from the other greenskins.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_first_5}Raknank Wolfsmakka is one of the Bloody Spearz clan's scouts. His discretion and stealth make him the ideal candidate to infiltrate the villages and camps that the tribe will later raid.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_first_6}Stizglops Gloomfinga was a goblin who was long held in slavery by the Chaos Dwarves. It is unknown how he managed to escape, but he was able to find refuge in the Worlds Edge Mountains living as a tracker for the Bloody Spearz clan.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_first_7}Dagzat Hackcrawla is the goblin archer most highly regarded by the Bloody Spearz clan. It's not because he's the most accurate at shooting; his shots are far from perfect. But he's the fastest at reloading his quiver and therefore the one who fires the most arrows per minute. Apparently, one saves valuable time by shooting without aiming.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_first_8}Stories tell of a time when Glartsnik Siksack was stationed at a small outpost where the other goblins would mock him, steal from him, and even play practical jokes on him that nearly cost him his life at the hands of a hungry squig. Glartsnik decided to take revenge by impaling the rest of his group on his spear. The brutality of his actions made Gnashrak think he would be a valuable addition to their ranks if he used that same fury on his enemies.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_1}Borguk Da Stabbiest is a fierce goblin who is renowned for, well, stabbing things. Borguk got his position by stabbing the Clan Chief, Snarg, and then feeding his corpse to the squigs. Now, Borguk is the Chief of the Dripping Dagger Clan, serving Gnashrak Gloomguzzler until he can stab him in the back.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_2}Shnozz ‘Eavy Toe is not very remarkable at all. In fact the only reason Shnozz has been leading a warband for Borguk is due to Shnozz being loyal. Shnozz is more cunningly brutal than his goblin brethren who are brutally cunning.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_3}Nothing excites Greebitz more than the sight of teeth. Not just orc or goblin teeth, but any beings' teeth. The current collection of teeth that Greebitz owns is in the thousands, most from humans, but ranging all the way from Dwarfs, Trolls, Arachnarok Spiders, and even a tooth of a long dead Grail Knight.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_4}Da Evil Heg has made a name across the Empire, but not like most warlords of the Night Goblins. Instead this warlord is a renowned schemer. Da Evil Heg uses vile concoctions, dreaded brews, and haggard colours to sow dissent into the realms of man. It is rumored that Da Evil Heg has delved into the arts of “Artistry,” something that no Greenskin even has the concept of.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_5}One of the cleverest and most sneaky Goblins, Sly Sweaty Bolloks has served under many warlords across the ages. Indeed, the little schemer has served under Skarsnik, the warlord of Eight Peaks, and even the long dead Grom the Paunch as one of his chief warlords. It's rumored that he may be the oldest goblin in existence, but there are none alive to back up that claim.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_6}Despite having equipment on par with a normal goblin, Skagzat Dirtgobbla prefers not to carry weapons at all. Although he does carry them to begin with, he prefers to throw them at the enemy and then jump on them and use his sharp teeth to hurt the opponent. Such is his thirst for blood.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_7}Skarglops Webspite is seen visiting forest goblins more often than he is in his own clan. He has spent so much time among them that he seems more comfortable with spiders than with the wolves or squigs of the Bloody Spearz clan. He may have grown up in the wrong tribe, but that doesn't make him any less willing to fight for it.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_bloody_spearz_second_8}Gitnibz Cackletongue is a shaman who consciously abuses mushrooms and other shamanic substances, causing him to constantly wander into a state of 'prophetic' madness. He keeps proclaiming crazy things like 'The End of Times', 'The Age of the God of Mankind', 'Noisy fire-powered chariots' and even ‘Boxes with unpainted toy boys’. Obviously, nobody believes him, but the rest of the goblins find this nonsense entertaining.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_factionleader}Kap’n Snozzsnik Skumclaw is the leader of the goblin tribe known as the Reavaz, which is located on the northwestern coast of Nordland, somewhere between Wrecker's Point and Manann’s Teeth. Not much is known about him or his way of running the clan (which should be no different than other goblins). But the few times he has been seen, he has been seen patrolling the region on the back of a huge wolf.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_2}Zonkgaz Badguzzla is one of the goblins who watches over the Reavaz clan's lair to make sure no souls come near. If they aren't deterred by the fierce, pointed rocks in the bay, the stranded ships, the corpses, or the chilling screams, he makes sure they get speared in the chest.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_3}Spiznogg Badspite has a little personal habit. He remembers very well the enemies he has killed in his ambushes, and after finishing the ambush, he cuts off both of their ears and makes grotesque little necklaces out of them that he always wears around his neck. When these ears start to rot, he moves on to another ambush to obtain new ‘trophies’.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_4}Nitstik Snotnose is one of the goblin shamans of the Reavaz clan. He serves a dual purpose, his main mission being to go into the forest in search of possible supplies, but he always ends up hearing rumors... such as those of a caravan that could be raided or a war party sent to hunt them down. Thus, his reports are a valuable source of information.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_5}Sliznab Loonsack is the 'smith' of the Reavaz clan. He's not a real smith. His main job is to take all the junk and trash the clan collects and 'repurpose' it to try and create rudimentary weapons or anything else the clan can use. Obviously, he keeps the best designs for himself.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_6}Dagnogg Sicktoof is one of the Reavaz clan's wolf breeders. He is also in charge of taming the wolves and teaching the other goblins how to ride them. Although, truth be told, his training consists almost exclusively of kicking them into the breeding grounds and hoping the wolves don't devour them.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_7}Slizgank Snidespit is able to blend into any environment and hide behind the smallest bush or even in tall grass. It can spend hours completely motionless, waiting for an unsuspecting traveler to pass by before it sneaks up and stabs its knife into their neck without making the slightest noise.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_8}Snuffglub Dampfinga is one of the goblin shamans of the Reavaz clan. He is rarely seen outside the clan hideout, as he lives deep within it, ensuring that the darkness and humidity are conducive to the mushrooms consumed by the shamans of his clan.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_9}Gitrank Squigbagz is a Nasty Skulker from the Reavaz clan. He is an expert in all kinds of weapons, from knives, spears, bows or even throwing weapons. But what he likes most is showing off how good a fighter he is to the rest of his clan members.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_10}Grullin Drizzlesack, the most annoying, repulsive, stinking, and irritating shaman a goblin clan could ever have. If it weren't for his mastery of Da Little Waaagh, he would have been thrown to the bottom of the sea by the claws long ago.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_11}One of the least prestigious goblins in the clan. Such is the contempt for him from the other goblins that he is not even considered for ambush parties. The only job he is forced to do is to row over and over again whenever there is a shipwreck to help other goblins collect the floating cargo. However, if he sees something he likes, he often throws his companion overboard to keep whatever the other has pulled from the sea.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_reavaz_first_12}Gibgat Poisonarmz is one of the goblins that the Reavaz clan uses to dive and try to search the bottom of the bay for the possible valuable merchandise of the reckless ships that run aground and are shipwrecked in the Manaan’s Tooth.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_factionleader}O’nery Backslider leads the Red Eye tribe from the ancient dwarven fortress of Karak Ungor on Red Eye Mountain. From his vantage point, he has a view for several leagues around him, and is able to spot enemy armies; such as those of the dwarves, who wish to reclaim their ancestral home, or traveling caravans that they can raid. Occasionally, he also faces hordes of Skaven deep within the fortress, attempting to assault his domain from below.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_2}Grotstik Gunkspit is a night goblin who takes charge of Red Eye Mountain when O’nery Backslider is away or doesn't feel like dealing with it.It is often seen patrolling the depths of the fortress in search of underground Skaven routes, as long as O’nery does not call him to his presence.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_3}Slitgaz Snotguzzla is the most powerful goblin shaman of the Red Eye tribe. None of the other shamans can even match Slitgaz's knowledge in Da Little Waaagh with their spells.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_4}Iggrit Slugsmakka is one of the goblin strategists of the Red Eyes tribe. It is not uncommon for him to take advantage of his position to take the shiniest loot from each ambush. Even if that means eliminating one of his minions to get it.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_5}The Red Eye tribe's chief squig breeder, Grotzat Toadtongue always has his spike ready to tease his hungry squigs and make them even more ferocious when the time comes. Grotzat is one lucky goblin, as he has yet to lose a limb while doing his work... yet.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_6}Stizlik Drizzlesmakka is the leader of the Red Eye clan's hunting party. According to him, anything goes to fill the goblins' larders, from the animals of the surrounding forests to the occasional unsuspecting intruder.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_7}Snufflak Shroomgobba is a master ambusher who spends most of his time setting traps on the paths that cross the mountains. Once a victim falls into one, his loud squeals of joy alert the rest of the clan to feast and steal his wares.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_8}Shubgur Lurchsponge is a ‘goblin’ only because he claims to be. The other goblins believe him since none of them have paid him enough attention, but if one of them were to look closely, he does have certain traits that could mistake him for a gnoblar. But the Red Eye tribe doesn't care. Either way, he is a member of the clan.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_9}Naffrunk Venomsplatta is one of the goblins who watch the inner reaches of the fortress for Skaven, often feeding on them. Unfortunately, the warpstone that was abundant in the skaven's body has passed into his body now, affecting his mind and causing him to act erratically (even for a goblin).

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_10}Snozzsnit Gloomskuttle is one of the strongest shamans of the Red Eyes tribe. He rarely leaves the depths of the fortress, spending his time hunting Skaven and experimenting on them.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_11}Snuffnank Gunkbelly is an average shaman of the Red Eye tribe. Despite not being as experienced as other shamans such as Snozzsnit or Slitgaz, he knows perfectly how to 'entertain' his superiors in order to climb the social ladder.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_first_12}Stogwonk Mothskuttle is a born fighter. He is always willing to fight other goblins and has always emerged victorious, earning him the title of 'the strongest goblin of the Red Eye tribe'. Despite this, his strength is still insignificant when compared to an average individual from any other race in the old world.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_1}Ragga the Red is a cunning Night Goblin who thrives on ambushes in the full light of day, a rarity among his kind. Most Night Goblins loathe the sun, skulking deep within the dark places of the world. Yet Ragga has turned that fear on its head. He knows that the Dwarf patrols and merchant caravans travelling through Peak Pass often feel safest under the noonday sun. It is precisely then that his warband strikes. Ragga's hatred for daylight is eclipsed only by his love of blood, used in strange rituals and mixed into foul fungus brew to enhance its potency. He and his band cloak themselves in shadowy hoods and blackened robes, yet Ragga himself smears his skin with a clotted mixture of Dwarf blood and cave-mud, believing it shields him from the sun’s touch. Whether this works or he simply endures the pain through madness is unclear as none of his kin dare imitate him. After each ambush, the slain and the wounded are dragged back to the camp, where they are bound and bled slowly into rusted cauldrons, their screams echoing through the crags. The Dwarfs have come to call him Zangrobi, “the Red Goblin” in Khazalid, and his name appears many times in the Dammaz Kron of Karak Kadrin. King Ungrim himself is said to have sworn a personal oath to see Ragga’s entrails hung from the gates of the hold.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_2}Gorkil is an ambitious Night Goblin warboss, though not the kind to be found in the thick of a fight. He leads from the rear. Far, far at the rear. Under his dubious command, his warband has pillaged countless caravans brave enough to move through Peak Pass. Ever watchful from the shadows, Gorkil has a keen eye for when things are about to turn sour. When a battle seems lost or the enemy proves too resilient, he doesn’t hesitate to scarper, often leaving his lads behind to buy him the time he needs to vanish into the rocks. Cowardice, some might say, but Gorkil calls it 'tactical foresight.'

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_3}Snagga rarely strays from the dark, winding caves he calls home, and if he does, it is only under the cloak of deepest night. Unlike most of his kind, it is not the sun he dreads, but being seen at all. So consumed is he by this fear that his mind has splintered; some say he mutters to shadows and lashes out at thin air, convinced he is ever watched by unseen eyes. He emerges only to raid when even the moons are little more than slivers in the sky. Survivors of such night-time assaults whisper of a deranged goblin, ranting and raving as he slaughtered all who dared glance in his direction. Few live to tell the tale, and none forget the madness in his eyes.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_4}Bagmuk is infamous across the tribe for his so-called “famous” Bloodrot Brew, a vile concoction blending whatever alcoholic swill he can scavenge, whether Dwarfen or Goblin in origin, with blood drawn from whatever remains he happens to have at hand. Be it the ichor of a freshly-squeezed Dwarf arm, the pulped juice of a horse’s leg, the clotted mess of a crushed human torso, or, the thick gore squeezed from a heap of Dwarf bodies, stomped flat into a red paste by over-eager trolls, Bagmuk considers it all fair game for fermentation. He roams far from the caves in search of “ingredients,” raiding travellers and border patrols alike to fuel his grotesque brewing experiments. Of late, he has developed a particular fondness for what he now calls “Bile Brew”,a noxious spirit made by mixing alcohol with the corpse-bile of the undead. Driven by this new obsession, Bagmuk has begun leading raids deeper into the east, ever eager to sample fresh sources for his revolting mixtures.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_5}Snagrat is rarely still, constantly prowling the dark tunnels and narrow passes in search of Dwarfen caravans, patrols, or wandering Skaven scouts. For reasons even other gobbos find strange, Snagrat harbours an intense hatred for hair of any kind. Dwarf beards and ratmen fur are the worst offenders,just the sight of them sends him into a snarling frenzy, clawing and slashing at the hairy foe until nothing remains but blood and silence. Wolves and trophy hides just about get a pass, barely, but truth be told, Snagrat would rather see the lot of it go up in flames.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_6}Daggit is the younger brother of Nobber, by mere seconds, and the pair are rarely seen without arguing over the best way to deal with the “twiggies in da west.” While Nobber favours simply killing the Elves outright, Daggit insists it’s better to loot their lands, torch their groves, and leave nothing worth returning to.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_7}Nobber is the elder brother of Daggit, by mere seconds, and the two are often at odds over the best way to trouble the “twiggies in da west.” It was Nobber who first stumbled upon the hidden paths leading into the Elven lands, and he wasted no time in sharing the secret with his brother, eager to cause as much trouble as possible amongst the tree-lovers. Nobber believes it is better to kill the elves outright, instead of worrying about their lands. Elves can’t return if they’re dead after all.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_greenskin_lord_red_eye_second_8}Digga loves digging for stuntie treasure in his spare time. You can almost spot some thin beard hairs on his chin...
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_chaos_lord_factionleader}Mortkin, also known as the 'Black-Iron Reaver,' is a mighty Chaos Lord and king of the Norscans.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_chaos_lord_brasskeep_factionleader}Pyucius the Dung Tongued is the current Warlord for the Repugnants of Brass Keep and is the current herald of the Putrid Blightkings in the Brass Keep. Pyucius was one of many Chaos warriors who assailed the Brass Keep long ago during the Great War Against Chaos, who became a half human, half daemonic mutant known as a Putrid Blightking. Although a most revolting and ruthless mutant to the empire, many of the Repugnants believe him to be endearing and a true son of Nurgle, believing him to herald a new wave of rot, death, and rebirth to the Empire of Man.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_chaos_lord_brasskeep_first_2}A frothing reaper of men, Squalm the Rabid is one of the Putrid Blightking champions assisting Pyucius the Dung Tongued in destroying the Empire for the glory of Nurgle. A fairly short and mutated monster of man and somewhat beast, Squalm is more warlord than most of his Nurgle brothers, preferring to destroy everything in his path so Grandfather Nurgle can rebuild from the wastes.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_chaos_lord_brasskeep_first_3}An ever living servant of the Carrion Lord, The Glophelm hails from the far north, well beyond Norsca and far into the Chaos Wastes. No one knows much about this being, only that it cannot speak in a normal tongue to most, mostly due to the fact that the beings face and helm are one. The Glophelm is a monster compared to most men, both in strength and height, and is a fearsome sight on the field.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_chaos_lord_brasskeep_first_4}Chosen even before birth, Malarius of Obelstein was born from a human mother whose husband had long since abandoned her. Before his malefic birth, a fly spawn of Bloab Rotspawn, father of all Chosen of Nurgle, had infected Malarius’ mother Elke. Unbeknownst to her, a plague child was brewing in her womb. After Elke’s passing from the disease of her own child, the nauseating half human half daemon spawn that emerged from her was sent far into the forest, where it would be found by Bleboth the Blighted Apothecary. Bleboth would mold the sickly child to become a sickening brute of a warrior.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_chaos_lord_brasskeep_first_5}Bleboth the Blighted Apothecary is the head apothecary for the Putrid Blightkings in Brass Keep, finding ways to concoct plagues and disease to spread through the Empire. Indeed, Bleboth is one of the few Blight Kings in Brass Keep who knows how to bend the Winds of Magic to his will, specifically the wind of Dhar. Although he prefers to concoct plagues in secret within the Citadel of Brass Keep, he will most joyously leave the confines of the slimy palace to experiment on his enemies.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_chaos_lord_brasskeep_first_6}Woerot the Tainted is a champion of Nurgle. He guards the Brasskeep against sneaky invaders like the skaven. When catching skaven he will use their body as vessel for new diseases to honor his god. By doing this he gets many blessings from Nurgle for his body is bloated and covered in poxes.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_de_lord_factionleader}Dreadlord of Kassna Kor

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_ungor_chief_factionleader}Ungrol Four-Horn, also known as Blackheart, Hornsthief, and the Spurned One, is a two-headed, mutant Ungor and budding Bray-Shaman who is consumed with bitterness and spite. There is no more hateful a creature in the Old World, for he has been cast out of the ranks of both Men and Beastmen.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_br_bergerac_leader}It is said that Bertrand, now known as the 'Brigand', was originally a poor peasant in the feudal domain of Bergerac, in the deeply forested heartland of Bretonnia. All was well until the old Baron de Bergerac went off on the Grail Quest and never returned. This was a long time ago. While the old Baron was away, Orcs came out of the forest and ravaged the entire domain. The situation for the peasants was increasingly desperate. Bertrand soon assumed the leadership of the peasants. While the nobles shut themselves up in the castle, he organised the villagers. They practiced archery every day until they were all marksmen. Bertrand made sure that every approach to the village was watched, and soon the Orc raiders were being driven off empty handed. Sometimes they were even pursued into the forest, the villagers felling the Orcs as they fled.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_br_bergerac_2} Gui le Gros is a member of the Bowmen of Bergerac under Bertrand the Brigand. A Bretonnian commoner fighting for the people like himself, ordinary Bretonnian peasants oppressed by their lords. On some occasions, he has also been known to ally with them in a fight against the common enemy, like Orcs & Goblins or Hordes of Chaos. He is known to be an excellent orator, as his speeches raise great quantities of people to arms wherever he treads, often making crucial difference between victory and defeat. He also never asks much for his services. In fact, just some fine food and drink will be enough to satisfy him, a fact that only adds to his popularity and reputation.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_br_bergerac_3} Hugo le Petit is a member of the Bowmen of Bergerac under Bertrand the Brigand. Renowned for his immense strength and size, he is the right hand man of Bertrand.He carries a vast staff and huge longbow whose arrows are more like javelins

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_br_wainfleet_leader}Sir Geg, or mostly known as 'The Peasant Knight', is the first and only peasant ever knighted in the lands of Bretonnia. Although many lords and ladies see the brawny peasant as no more than what he was born as, Sir Geg was gifted the Grail from The Lady, and supped from the grail afore many of his fellow peasants. Now, sir Geg claims the lands of Wainfleet as his own, protecting the poor and innocent with his life.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_br_troubadour_leader}Sir Tristan the Troubadour is a Bretonnian questing knight and minstrel who regularly travels the length and breadth of the whole kingdom. Despite not yet ascending into the holiness of the Lady, many regard Tristan with the same respect as they would a grail knight. Into battle he rides, singing all the while to inspire both himself and those around him; it's said his swordwork is as beautiful as the songs he sings or plays on his lute.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_br_troubadour_2}Jules le Jongleur is a jester, a mimic and the sworn companion of Tristan le Troubadour the singing knight. When Tristan went on his grail quest Jules begged him if he could join him. Tristan agreed with this and the two have been on adventure ever since. Over the years of Tristan's quest, the mismatched duo have seen many strange things and battled countless terrible foes, ranging from the diminutive but vicious Goblin warlords, To the big beastman herd leaders. Jules isn't a fighter but he is very good in distracting the enemy to give Tristan a advantage. It is said that jules can mimic every existing creature in the old world a skill not many posses.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dog_clan_hero_braganza}The ingenious Borgio the Besieger, the Prince of Miragliano, originally employed the famous regiment of Besiegers, as a special siege unit of crossbowmen during times of war. Borgio wanted marksmen who could pick off defenders on the walls at close range in the face incoming enemy missiles, hold ramparts against assaults, provide missile support for their main infantry, sappers, miners, siege towers, and if need be, stand their ground against enemy units sallying out of the besieged fortress. Bragnaza's troops soon proved their worth in Borgio's many sieges and turned out to be equally good as a rearguard in open battle.

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dog_clan_hero_cursed}The most common tales revolving around Richter Kreugar's tragic curse tell of a young mercenary captain, proud, talented, and ruthless. He hired out his services freely, uncaring who he fought for as long as the price was right. Centuries ago in the history of the Old World, Richer was said to have allied with a powerful Necromancer, aiding him in his diabolical campaign against the Empire, terrorizing the heavily forested area around Wolfenburg.
{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dog_clan_hero_leopard}Stiffen the Sinews, summon the blood, disguise fair nature with hard - favoured rage and imitate the actions of the Leopard!

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dog_clan_hero_voland}We are Voland's Venators... The Drunken Calvary!... We cannot march, we cannot fight... What wretched knights are we!... But when we see the enemy... Our heads are very clear... We Charge straight for their baggage camp... and liberate their gears!

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dog_clan_hero_miragliano}JOIN US....are you good enough to fight alongside the best warriors in the world?.....THE MARKSMEN OF MIRAGLIANO ARE LOOKING FOR MORE MEN TO JOIN THEIR RANKS!.....if you can handle a crossbow and a life of adventure come to the Merry Archer at noon!.....WE HIT THE RIGHT SPOT EVERY TIME!

{=str_encyclopedia_tor_dog_clan_hero_ricco}No, they didn't look dangerous, more like a bunch of rich kids out to show off in their new armour. Very flashy they were, all gems and silk. We'll have a bit of fun, we thought. Easy pickings, we thought. Well anyone can make a mistake. Poor old captain Malvino, last mistake he ever made...
